name: forgets
description: An independent TypeScript software factory learning project with a persisted mock workflow.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.build: npm run build -w @forgets/contracts && npm run build -w @forgets/core && npm run build -w @forgets/agents && npm run build -w @forgets/persistence && npm run build -w @forgets/api && npm run build -w @forgets/cli
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npm run test:integration -w @forgets/persistence && npm run test:integration -w @forgets/api
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run build && npm run lint && npm run typecheck --workspaces && npm run test --workspaces
